definition: Exact USGS NWIS site number; retained as text.
calculation_method: Exact NWIS site ID; verified against NLDI identifier and requested coordinates.

definition: USGS-reported total drainage area; not replaced by the NLDI polygon area.
data_source: USGS NWIS; project source drainage-area CSV
calculation_method: Exact station ID; verified against saved NWIS RDB and NHDPlus comparison in boundary report.
missing_data_explanation: NWIS and NLDI/NHDPlus conflicts are flagged in the quality report for 07010000 and 08158000.

definition: USGS-reported contributing drainage area, distinct from total drainage area.
data_source: USGS NWIS; project source drainage-area CSV
calculation_method: Exact station ID; blank if NWIS does not report a value.
missing_data_explanation: NWIS reports this only for 08158000 among the four stations.

definition: Mean 3DEP elevation over the gage-split NLDI basin.
calculation_method: 30 m pixel-size request; 150 km tiles in EPSG:5070; tile means weighted by the equal-area intersection of each tile with the basin. Complete elevation tiles only.
missing_data_explanation: Blank where one or more required 3DEP elevation tiles failed.

definition: Minimum 3DEP elevation pixel in the gage-split basin.
calculation_method: Minimum of tile-level raster minima over the basin; 30 m request; EPSG:5070.
missing_data_explanation: May include mapped water/bathymetric pixels; negative results are flagged in the report.

definition: Maximum 3DEP elevation pixel in the gage-split basin.
calculation_method: Maximum of tile-level raster maxima over the basin; 30 m request; EPSG:5070.
missing_data_explanation: Blank where one or more required 3DEP elevation tiles failed.

definition: Area-weighted mean percent-rise terrain slope derived from 3DEP.
calculation_method: Server-side Slope function, ZFactor=1, SlopeType=2 (percent rise), RemoveEdgeEffect=true; output retained only if all tiles complete and returned values pass a range/edge-artifact screen.
missing_data_explanation: Blank if slope tile results are incomplete or implausible; no channel-slope or external proxy substituted.

definition: Mean 30 m fractional impervious surface over the basin.
data_source: USGS Annual NLCD Fractional Impervious Surface
calculation_method: 2024 mosaic selection; 30 m cells; zonal service statistics over 150 km EPSG:5070 basin intersections; pixel-count-weighted mean.

definition: Share of valid 30 m land-cover cells classified as evergreen, deciduous, or mixed forest.
calculation_method: 2024 mosaic; classes 41, 42, 43; histogram cell counts divided by valid land-cover cell count.

definition: Share of valid land-cover cells in developed open space and low/medium/high intensity developed classes.
calculation_method: 2024 mosaic; classes 21, 22, 23, 24; histogram cell counts divided by valid land-cover cell count.

definition: Mapped NWI wetland polygon area clipped to basin, divided by basin area; excludes mapped deepwater classes.
calculation_method: Planned method: clip NWI polygon features to exact basin in EPSG:5070 and divide mapped wetland area by basin area. No value published until complete feature pagination finishes.
period_or_version: Live layer; feature mapping dates not exposed
missing_data_explanation: Blank because only partial pages were retrieved and the station-level fetch was stopped to prioritize 3DEP.

definition: Share of basin soil-component area assigned to Hydrologic Soil Group A.
data_source: USDA NRCS SSURGO / Soil Data Access
calculation_method: Not calculated; requires clipped mapunit area joined to component hydgrp. Dual groups need an explicitly selected drained/undrained scenario.
missing_data_explanation: No SSURGO AOI extraction completed in this first version.

definition: Share of basin soil-component area assigned to Hydrologic Soil Group B.
data_source: USDA NRCS SSURGO / Soil Data Access
calculation_method: Not calculated; requires clipped mapunit area joined to component hydgrp.
missing_data_explanation: No SSURGO AOI extraction completed in this first version.

definition: Share of basin soil-component area assigned to Hydrologic Soil Group C.
data_source: USDA NRCS SSURGO / Soil Data Access
calculation_method: Not calculated; requires clipped mapunit area joined to component hydgrp.
missing_data_explanation: No SSURGO AOI extraction completed in this first version.

definition: Share of basin soil-component area assigned to Hydrologic Soil Group D.
data_source: USDA NRCS SSURGO / Soil Data Access
calculation_method: Not calculated; dual A/D, B/D and C/D should be preserved as alternatives or clearly assigned to a stated scenario.
missing_data_explanation: No SSURGO AOI extraction completed in this first version.

definition: Area- and component-weighted profile available-water capacity.
units: Not populated; target unit mm water per 1 m soil profile
calculation_method: Planned: join AOI-clipped mapunit area to component fractions and horizon awc_r; integrate horizon overlap to a stated soil depth.
missing_data_explanation: No basin-wide component/horizon profile extraction completed.

definition: Area- and component-weighted saturated hydraulic conductivity.
calculation_method: Planned: thickness-weighted profile average from horizon ksat_r, converted from SSURGO units only after confirming field metadata.
missing_data_explanation: No basin-wide component/horizon profile extraction completed.

definition: 1991–2020 mean annual precipitation, spatially averaged over the basin.
calculation_method: Annual 4 km PRISM grid (M3; 1991–2020). Each grid cell was intersected with the basin after transform to EPSG:5070; cell precipitation weighted by clipped cell area.
